title: Affine locally free extension core
statement: theorem exists_affine_locally_free_model_core (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing A] (W : (Spec A).Opens) (P : W.toScheme.Modules) [P.IsFiniteLocallyFree] : ∃ H : (Spec A).Modules, H.IsQuasicoherent ∧ (∀ V : (Spec A).Opens, IsAffineOpen V → Module.Finite ((Spec A).presheaf.obj (op V)) (H.val.obj (op V))) ∧ Nonempty (Modules.restrict H W.ι ≅ P)

proof.text: Finite presentation extension and affine module identification produce H; transport the finite locally free restriction isomorphism.

theorem exists_affine_locally_free_model_core
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsNoetherianRing A] (W : (Spec A).Opens)
    (P : W.toScheme.Modules) [P.IsFiniteLocallyFree] :
    ∃ H : (Spec A).Modules,
      H.IsQuasicoherent ∧
      (∀ V : (Spec A).Opens, IsAffineOpen V →
        Module.Finite ((Spec A).presheaf.obj (op V)) (H.val.obj (op V))) ∧
      Nonempty (Modules.restrict H W.ι ≅ P)
